data.cultural_impact: Raphaël is a Christian name deeply rooted in Jewish and Christian traditions. In Jewish belief, Raphaël is an angel who appears in the Old Testament book of Tobit and is sent to heal Tobit's blindness and Sarah's infertility. In the Christian faith, Raphaël is revered as a powerful healer and saint. He is invoked for physical and spiritual healing, and numerous churches and shrines are dedicated to him.
